//: Composite indexes required by lore-gcp's Firestore-backed mutable and immutable stores.
Deploy with `gcloud firestore indexes composite create --database=<db>` (one call per
entry below, translating the JSON fields), via Terraform `google_firestore_index`
resources, or `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes` if this file is adopted into a
Firebase project config. This repository does not provision live Firestore
infrastructure; this file documents exactly what the infra workstream needs to create,
and the collectionGroup names below must be kept in sync with the collection names
configured in a deployment's [plugins.gcp] section (defaults shown here).
- mutable_store (partition ASC, key ASC): lore_gcp::store::mutable_store's list(partition,
key_type) filters on an equality match for `partition` together with a range (>=, <=) on
`key`; that combination needs a declared composite index. Corresponds to
[plugins.gcp].firestore_mutable_store_collection.
- fragment_associations (hash ASC, partition ASC): lore_gcp::store::immutable_store's
has_partition_association is an equality-only compound filter (hash == X AND
partition == Y), used by ImmutableStore::copy's zero-context source resolution.
Declared explicitly rather than relying on Firestore's automatic-index support for
multi-equality queries. Corresponds to
[plugins.gcp].firestore_fragment_associations_collection.
Single-field indexes (equality or range on one field alone) are automatic in Firestore
and are not listed here.
